data.description: Fully Furnished | Mid Floor | Creek View
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to present this stunning 1-bedroom apartment for rent in Binghatti Creek, Al Jaddaf, offering a perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience in a well-connected location.

This fully furnished apartment spans 666 sq. ft. and features a thoughtfully designed layout with 1 spacious bedroom and 2 modern bathrooms. Positioned on a mid-floor, the unit enjoys a pleasant creek view, creating a relaxing and bright living environment. Large windows allow natural light to fill the space, enhancing the overall ambiance.

The apartment is vacant and ready to move in, making it an ideal choice for professionals or couples seeking a hassle-free living experience. The interiors are well-maintained and furnished with quality pieces, ensuring both comfort and functionality.

Property Features:

1 Bedroom
2 Bathrooms
Size: 666 sq. ft.
Fully furnished
Mid-floor unit
Creek view
1 covered parking space

Rental Details:

AED 80,000
Up to 3 cheques

Located in Al Jaddaf, residents benefit from easy access to major roads, Downtown Dubai, and key business districts.

For more information or to arrange a viewing, please contact us today.
